title: Farmer Blocks
description: This mod adds Ore Farmer Blocks without ruining the game's balance
body:
Farmer Blocks is a Minecraft mod that allows players to craft **ore generators** that **automatically produce ores** without ruining the game's balance.

![Normal Iron Farmer Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42ed485f3b8c5ba62888c3160c339bf6147d5f0d_0.webp)![Upgraded Emerlad Farmer Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d20e04b6b50a11893fe6608db2fd6da6f12d9473.png)![Prime DIamond Farmer Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2da7fe2e50758bc58551ace2b65e130c6c00c2a1.png)

It introduces Normal, Upgraded and Prime generators of every ore from Coal to Diamond that generates you ores.

This eliminates the need for extensive mining, giving players a more efficient way to gather resources.


| Weak (only diamond and emerald) | Normal | Upgraded | Prime |
|-------------------------------|:------:|---------:|------:|
| 20 seconds                              | 10 seconds       | 5 seconds         | 2 seconds      |
